type.quote: The state medical board shall review all applications submitted under section 4731.09 of the Revised Code

age_minimum.quote: Be at least eighteen years of age

degree_required.quote: Hold a diploma from a medical school or osteopathic medical school that, at the time the diploma was issued, was a medical school accredited by the liaison committee on medical education or an osteopathic medical school accredited by the American osteopathic association

credential_pegged.quote: Hold a diploma from a medical school or osteopathic medical school that, at the time the diploma was issued, was a medical school accredited by the liaison committee on medical education

exams.notes: Board prescribes by rule; the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact references USMLE and COMLEX-USA as acceptable examinations

interval_years.quote: A license issued under this chapter to practice medicine and surgery, osteopathic medicine and surgery, or podiatric medicine and surgery shall be valid for a two-year period unless revoked or suspended.

renewal_fee_usd.quote: Each application shall be accompanied by a biennial renewal fee of three hundred five dollars.

required.quote: each person holding a license to practice medicine and surgery, osteopathic medicine and surgery, or podiatric medicine and surgery issued by the state medical board shall complete biennially not less than fifty hours of continuing medical education that has been approved by the board.

hours_per_period.quote: shall complete biennially not less than fifty hours of continuing medical education that has been approved by the board.

period_years.quote: shall complete biennially not less than fifty hours of continuing medical education

available.quote: The state medical board may issue, without examination, to an applicant who meets all of the requirements of this section an expedited license to practice medicine and surgery or osteopathic medicine and surgery by endorsement.

requirements.value: Expedited licensure by endorsement available for applicants who have held an unrestricted Canadian provincial license for 5 years, actively practiced for 2 years, passed USMLE or COMLEX, and meet Ohio education requirements. Ohio is also a member of the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact providing an additional expedited pathway.
requirements.quote: The 'Interstate Medical Licensure Compact' is hereby ratified, enacted into law, and entered into by the state of Ohio as a party to the compact

national_association.quote: An internship, residency, or clinical fellowship program conducted in the United States and accredited by either the accreditation council for graduate medical education of the American medical association or the American osteopathic association

title_protection.quote: No person shall advertise or claim to the public to be a practitioner of medicine and surgery, or any of its branches, without a license or certificate from the board.

scope_protection.quote: No person shall practice medicine and surgery, or any of its branches, without the appropriate license or certificate from the state medical board to engage in the practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud during the examination or in applying for, renewing, or securing any license or certificate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: committed fraud during the administration of the examination for a license or certificate to practice or to have committed fraud, misrepresentation, or deception in applying for, renewing, or securing any license or certificate to practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting one's name or license to be used by a person not actually directing the treatment given
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitting one's name or one's license or certificate to practice to be used by a person, group, or corporation when the individual concerned is not actually directing the treatment given

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain minimal standards in selection or administration of drugs or failure to employ acceptable scientific methods
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to maintain minimal standards applicable to the selection or administration of drugs, or failure to employ acceptable scientific methods in the selection of drugs or other modalities for treatment of disease

disciplinary_grounds.description: Selling, giving away, prescribing, or administering drugs for other than legal and legitimate therapeutic purposes or drug law violations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: selling, giving away, personally furnishing, prescribing, or administering drugs for other than legal and legitimate therapeutic purposes or a plea of guilty to, a judicial finding of guilt of, or a judicial finding of eligibility for intervention in lieu of conviction of, a violation of any federal or state law regulating the possession, distribution, or use of any drug

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully betraying a professional confidence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully betraying a professional confidence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a false, fraudulent, deceptive, or misleading statement in soliciting patients or in relation to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making a false, fraudulent, deceptive, or misleading statement in the solicitation of or advertising for patients; in relation to the practice of medicine and surgery, osteopathic medicine and surgery, podiatric medicine and surgery, or a limited branch of medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Departure from or failure to conform to minimal standards of care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A departure from, or the failure to conform to, minimal standards of care of similar practitioners under the same or similar circumstances, whether or not actual injury to a patient is established

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing that an incurable condition can be permanently cured for personal gain
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Representing, with the purpose of obtaining compensation or other advantage as personal gain or for any other person, that an incurable disease or injury, or other incurable condition, can be permanently cured

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining money or value by fraudulent misrepresentations in the course of practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The obtaining of, or attempting to obtain, money or anything of value by fraudulent misrepresentations in the course of practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Plea of guilty to, judicial finding of guilt of, or eligibility for intervention in lieu of conviction for a felony
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A plea of guilty to, a judicial finding of guilt of, or a judicial finding of eligibility for intervention in lieu of conviction for, a felony

disciplinary_grounds.description: Plea or finding of guilt for a misdemeanor committed in the course of practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A plea of guilty to, a judicial finding of guilt of, or a judicial finding of eligibility for intervention in lieu of conviction for, a misdemeanor committed in the course of practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Plea or finding of guilt for a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A plea of guilty to, a judicial finding of guilt of, or a judicial finding of eligibility for intervention in lieu of conviction for, a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of conditions of limitation placed by the board on a license or certificate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of the conditions of limitation placed by the board upon a license or certificate to practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to pay license renewal fees
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to pay license renewal fees specified in this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in division of fees for referral of patients or receiving value for a specific patient referral
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaging in the division of fees for referral of patients, or the receiving of a thing of value in return for a specific referral of a patient to utilize a particular service or business

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of a code of ethics of a recognized national professional organization
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violation of any provision of a code of ethics of the American medical association, the American osteopathic association, the American podiatric medical association, or any other national professional organizations that the board specifies by rule

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice according to acceptable standards by reason of mental or physical illness
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inability to practice according to acceptable and prevailing standards of care by reason of mental illness or physical illness, including, but not limited to, physical deterioration that adversely affects cognitive, motor, or perceptive skills.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or attempting to violate any provision of this chapter or any rule promulgated by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violating or attempting to violate, directly or indirectly, or assisting in or abetting the violation of, or conspiring to violate, any provisions of this chapter or any rule promulgated by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Limitation, revocation, suspension, or other adverse action against license by another licensing agency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any of the following actions taken by an agency responsible for authorizing, certifying, or regulating an individual to practice a health care occupation or provide health care services in this state or another jurisdiction, for any reason other than the nonpayment of fees: the limitation, revocation, or suspension of an individual's license to practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation or suspension of DEA registration or termination of clinical privileges by military/VA
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The revocation, suspension, restriction, reduction, or termination of clinical privileges by the United States department of defense or department of veterans affairs or the termination or suspension of a certificate of registration to prescribe drugs by the drug enforcement administration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Termination or suspension from participation in medicare or medicaid programs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Termination or suspension from participation in the medicare or medicaid programs by the department of health and human services or other responsible agency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impairment of ability to practice due to substance use disorder or excessive use of drugs or alcohol
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Impairment of ability to practice according to acceptable and prevailing standards of care because of substance use disorder or excessive use or abuse of drugs, alcohol, or other substances that may impair ability to practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to use universal blood and body fluid precautions established by board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to use universal blood and body fluid precautions established by rules adopted under section 4731.051 of the Revised Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to cooperate in a board investigation including failure to comply with subpoenas or answer questions truthfully
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to cooperate in an investigation conducted by the board under division (F) of this section, including failure to comply with a subpoena or order issued by the board or failure to answer truthfully a question presented by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with standards for operation of or care at a pain management clinic
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the standards and procedures established in rules under section 4731.054 of the Revised Code for the operation of or the provision of care at a pain management clinic

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with drug database review requirements when prescribing opioids or benzodiazepines
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the requirements of section 4729.79 or 4731.055 of the Revised Code, unless the state board of pharmacy no longer maintains a drug database

establishment_regulation_required.quote: The board may inspect either of the following as the board determines necessary to ensure compliance with this chapter and any rules adopted under it regarding pain management clinics: (a) A pain management clinic; (b) A facility or physician practice that the board suspects is operating as a pain management clinic in violation of this chapter.

definition_quote.value: A person shall be regarded as practicing medicine and surgery, osteopathic medicine and surgery, or podiatric medicine and surgery, within the meaning of this chapter, who does any of the following: Uses the words or letters 'Dr.,' 'Doctor,' 'M.D.,' physician,' 'D.O.,' 'D.P.M.,' or any other title ... in any way that represents the person as engaged in the practice ... or who examines or diagnoses for compensation ... or prescribes, advises, recommends, administers, or dispenses ... a drug or medicine, appliance, mold or cast, application, operation, or treatment, of whatever nature, for the cure or relief of a wound, fracture or bodily injury, infirmity, or disease.
definition_quote.quote: A person shall be regarded as practicing medicine and surgery, osteopathic medicine and surgery, or podiatric medicine and surgery, within the meaning of this chapter, who does any of the following

approximate.matched_normalized: a person shall be regarded as practicing medicine and surgery osteopathic medicine and surgery or podiatric medicine and surgery within the meaning of

value: prescribing, advising, recommending, administering, or dispensing drugs or medicines
administering appliances, operations, or treatment for the cure or relief of injury, infirmity, or disease
methods_authorized.quote: Examines or diagnoses for compensation of any kind, direct or indirect; Prescribes, advises, recommends, administers, or dispenses for compensation of any kind, direct or indirect, a drug or medicine, appliance, mold or cast, application, operation, or treatment, of whatever nature, for the cure or relief of a wound, fracture or bodily injury, infirmity, or disease.

drug_authority.value: Physicians authorized to prescribe, personally furnish, administer, and dispense drugs including controlled substances subject to rules adopted by the board; opioid analgesics and benzodiazepines subject to drug database review requirements
drug_authority.quote: Prescribes, advises, recommends, administers, or dispenses for compensation of any kind, direct or indirect, a drug or medicine, appliance, mold or cast, application, operation, or treatment

license_status_types.quote: An individual who holds a current, valid license issued under this chapter and who retires voluntarily from the practice of medicine and surgery, osteopathic medicine and surgery, or podiatric medicine and surgery or a limited branch of medicine may request that the state medical board place the individual's license on retired status.

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must hold ECFMG certification and complete at least 24 months of graduate medical education (second-year level). If undergraduate education was completed outside the US, must demonstrate English language proficiency by passing a board-specified examination, unless already required by ECFMG or meets exceptions based on prior US practice.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: Hold certification from the educational commission for foreign medical graduates and have successfully completed not less than twenty-four months of graduate medical education through the second-year level of graduate medical education or its equivalent as determined by the board

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: have successfully completed not less than twelve months of graduate medical education through the first-year level of graduate medical education or its equivalent as determined by the board

pain_management_education_required.quote: The board shall approve one or more continuing medical education courses of study included within the programs certified by the Ohio state medical association and the Ohio osteopathic association under divisions (B)(1) and (2) of this section that assist doctors of medicine and doctors of osteopathic medicine in both of the following: (1) Recognizing the signs of domestic violence and its relationship to child abuse; (2) Diagnosing and treating chronic pain

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: Physicians must review the state drug database before initially prescribing opioid analgesics or benzodiazepines and periodically thereafter at intervals not exceeding 90 days. Special requirements apply for minors. Chronic pain management by controlled substances is permitted subject to board rules including documentation, periodic assessment, and consultation requirements.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: Except as provided in divisions (C) and (E) of this section, a physician shall comply with all of the following as conditions of prescribing a drug that is either an opioid analgesic or a benzodiazepine, or personally furnishing a complete or partial supply of such a drug, as part of a patient's course of treatment for a particular condition

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: in the case of an applicant who prescribes or personally furnishes opioid analgesics or benzodiazepines, as defined in section 3719.01 of the Revised Code, the applicant shall certify to the board whether the applicant has been granted access to the drug database established and maintained by the state board of pharmacy pursuant to section 4729.75 of the Revised Code.

pain_management_clinic_registration_requ.quote: Practicing at a facility that is subject to licensure as a category III terminal distributor of dangerous drugs with a pain management clinic classification unless the person operating the facility has obtained and maintains the license with the classification

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Physicians may provide telehealth services in accordance with section 4743.09. Boards may require initial in-person visit for new patients before prescribing schedule II controlled substances (with exceptions for hospice/palliative care, medication-assisted treatment, mental health conditions, and emergencies). Rules must set standard of care equal to in-person standard.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: A physician may provide telehealth services in accordance with sections 4743.09 of the Revised Code.

telemedicine_license_available.quote: A physician may provide telehealth services in accordance with sections 4743.09 of the Revised Code.

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: The 'Interstate Medical Licensure Compact' is hereby ratified, enacted into law, and entered into by the state of Ohio as a party to the compact

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: Failure of a physician supervising a physician assistant to maintain supervision in accordance with the requirements of Chapter 4730. of the Revised Code and the rules adopted under that chapter

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: Any insurer providing professional liability insurance to an individual authorized to practice under this chapter, or any other entity that seeks to indemnify the professional liability of such an individual, shall notify the board within thirty days after the final disposition of any written claim for damages where such disposition results in a payment exceeding twenty-five thousand dollars.

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: Within thirty days after the imposition of any formal disciplinary action taken by any health care facility, including a hospital, health care facility operated by a health insuring corporation, ambulatory surgical center, or similar facility, against any individual holding a valid license or certificate to practice issued pursuant to this chapter, the chief administrator or executive officer of the facility shall report to the state medical board

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: The state medical board shall establish a confidential, nondisciplinary program for the evaluation and treatment of practitioners and applicants who are, or may be, impaired and also meet the eligibility conditions described in section 4731.252 or 4731.253 of the Revised Code. The program shall be known as the confidential monitoring program.

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: The board also may compel the individual to submit to a mental examination, physical examination, including an HIV test, or both a mental and a physical examination.

investigational_drug_protection.quote: Except for actions constituting willful or wanton misconduct, a treating physician who recommends or treats an eligible patient with an investigational drug, product, or device in compliance with this section is not liable for or subject to any of the following for an action or omission related to treatment with the investigational drug, product, or device: damages in any civil action, prosecution in any criminal proceeding, or professional disciplinary action.
